title: Sustained non-fifth dyad does NOT escalate
purpose: confirms only perfect-fifth dyads escalate to power chord. Other intervals stay melody regardless of duration.
expected_prose:
Held for 6 beats at 120 BPM, well past
DYAD_SUSTAIN_THRESHOLD. Escalation tries to fire, but the interval
(major third = 4 semitones) does not match the power-chord template
(interval 7). No chord declared. state=melody throughout.
